Type=simple
ExecStart={ path=/opt/mix/bin/noded ; argv[]=/opt/mix/bin/noded serve --no-monitor --no-log ; ignore_errors=no ; start_time=[n/a] ; stop_time=[n/a] ; pid=0 ; code=(null) ; status=0/0 }
User=desktop
RuntimeDirectory=example/session/5/noded
EnvironmentFiles=/etc/example/session/5.env (ignore_errors=no)
EnvironmentFiles=/var/lib/example/desk-bus/etc/noded/service.env (ignore_errors=no)
UnsetEnvironment=DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS DBUS_STARTER_ADDRESS DBUS_STARTER_BUS_TYPE DBUS_SYSTEM_BUS_ADDRESS
KillMode=control-group
